# Load libraries
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(car)
library(lattice)
library(dplyr)
```

# Load and initialize dataset
```{r}
school_data <- read.csv("C:/Users/Jet/OneDrive/Documenten/Universiteit/Motivation SA/Gegevens_scholen_anoniem(Anonieme_gegevens_scholen).csv")
schoolweging_data <- read.csv("C:/Users/Jet/OneDrive/Documenten/Universiteit/Motivation SA/schoolweging_csv.csv", fileEncoding = "UTF-8")

school_data <- school_data %>%
  mutate(
    Provincie = as.character(Provincie),
    Schoolweging = as.numeric(Schoolweging),
    stedelijkheid = as.numeric(stedelijkheid),
    gemiddelde_SES = as.numeric(gemiddelde_SES),
    Schoolweging_z = scale(Schoolweging, center = T, scale = T),
    stedelijkheid_z = scale(stedelijkheid, center = T, scale = T),
    SES_z = scale(gemiddelde_SES, center = T, scale = T))


schoolweging_data$schoolweging_z <- scale(schoolweging_data$schoolweging)
```

# Make graphs

```{r}
library(gtsummary)

tabl1 <- school_data |> tbl_summary(
  include = c(Provincie, Schoolweging, stedelijkheid, gemiddelde_SES),
  statistic = list(
      all_continuous() ~ "{mean} ({sd})",
      all_categorical() ~ "{n} / {N} ({p}%)"
    ),
    digits = all_continuous() ~ 2,
    missing_text = "(Missing)")
                                  
tabl1 |>
  as_gt() |>
  gt::gtsave(filename = "table.docx")
```


# Create sample and reference schoolweging histograms
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
library(wesanderson)

# Create universal labels for all graphs
size_title = 15
size_title_axis = 18
size_text_axis = 15
color_text = "black"

# Schoolweging sample
Schoolweging_hist <- ggplot(school_data, aes(x = Schoolweging)) + 
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 1, colour = "white", fill = wes_palette("Zissou1", 1)) + 
  xlab("Norm scored mean schoolweging") + ylab("Count") +
  ggtitle("Pupil complexity (schoolweging) for participating schools \n (1 January 2022 - 1 January 2025)") +
  theme_pubr() + scale_x_continuous(n.breaks = 10) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(color=color_text, size=size_title, face="bold", hjust = 0.5),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = size_text_axis),
    axis.title.y = element_text(color=color_text, size=size_title_axis),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = size_text_axis),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = size_text_axis),
    legend.title=element_text(size=size_title_axis), 
    legend.text=element_text(size=size_text_axis),
    strip.background =  element_blank(),
    legend.position = "right")

Schoolweging_hist

ggsave("schoolweging_hist_sample.png")


# Schoolweging reference

Schoolweging_hist <- ggplot(schoolweging_data, aes(x = schoolweging_z)) + 
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.2, colour = "white", fill = wes_palette("Moonrise1", 1)) + 
  xlab("Norm scored mean schoolweging") + ylab("Count") +
  ggtitle("Pupil complexity (schoolweging) for all Dutch schools \n (1 January 2022 - 1 January 2025)") +
  theme_pubr() + scale_x_continuous(n.breaks = 10) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(color=color_text, size=size_title, face="bold", hjust = 0.5),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = size_text_axis),
    axis.title.y = element_text(color=color_text, size=size_title_axis),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = size_text_axis),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = size_text_axis),
    legend.title=element_text(size=size_title_axis), 
    legend.text=element_text(size=size_text_axis),
    strip.background =  element_blank(),
    legend.position = "right")

Schoolweging_hist

ggsave("schoolweging_hist_ref_z.png")
```

# Add graph for SES
```{r}
# SES sample
SES_hist <- ggplot(school_data, aes(x = SES_z)) + 
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.2, colour = "white", fill = wes_palette("FantasticFox1", 1)) + 
  xlab("Norm scored mean SES-WOA") + ylab("Count") +
  ggtitle("Socio-economic status for participating schools \n (1 January 2022 - 1 January 2025)") +
  theme_pubr() + scale_x_continuous(n.breaks = 10) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(color=color_text, size=size_title, face="bold", hjust = 0.5),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = size_text_axis),
    axis.title.y = element_text(color=color_text, size=size_title_axis),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = size_text_axis),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = size_text_axis),
    legend.title=element_text(size=size_title_axis), 
    legend.text=element_text(size=size_text_axis),
    strip.background =  element_blank(),
    legend.position = "right")

SES_hist

ggsave("SES_hist_sample.png")
```


```{r}
ggplot(data_pGo, aes(x = condition_type, y = pGo, fill = condition_type)) +
  facet_grid(cols = vars(session),rows = vars(controllability))+
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge(), width = 0.7) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = pGo - pGo_se, ymax = pGo + pGo_se), 
                position = position_dodge(0.7), width = 0.2) +
  geom_point(data = data_pGo_ind, aes(x = condition_type, y = pGo, group = condition_type),
             alpha = 0.5, shape=21, fill = "black", inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0,1))+ scale
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Go to Win" = "darkgoldenrod2", "Go to Avoid" = "steelblue3", 
                                "No Go to Win" = "khaki2", "No Go to Avoid" = "skyblue1")) +
  ylab("Proportion of go responses") +
  ggtitle("Probability of go responses (ses*controllability*condition)") +
  labs(fill = "Condition Type") +
  theme_pubr() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(color=color_text, size=size_title, face="bold", hjust = 0.5),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_text(color=color_text, size=size_title_axis, face="bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = size_text_axis),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = size_text_axis),
    legend.title=element_text(size=size_title_axis), 
    legend.text=element_text(size=size_text_axis),
    strip.background =  element_blank(),
    legend.position = "right")
```
